data.description:
Hitting '?' or clicking a 'Help (?)' button next to the 'Index' button should pause the game and bring up a screen that lists all the powerups available in that gym scene. It will have the icon and a description of what it does.

---

*Migrated from ContextHub work item `WL-0MTPLA9BT008HWVL` (misfiled in the ContextHub project; belongs to AI_Hell).*

---

## Intake brief

**Headline:** Add a shared `Help (?)` affordance to the three power-up/weapon gym scenes that pauses the gym and shows a code-drawn icon, name and one-line description for every drop that gym can spawn, with the copy sourced from the shared catalogues.

### Problem statement

The power-up and weapon gym scenes are the project's primary tuning and demonstration surfaces, but a player or developer arriving in a gym has no way to learn what each drop on the field actually does short of reading the GDD. The gyms need an in-context help overlay that pauses the gym and shows, for every drop that gym can spawn, the drop's icon, its name and a one-line description.

### Users and user stories

- **As a developer tuning a gym**, I want to press `?` (or click a `Help (?)` button) and see the icon + effect of every drop this gym can spawn, so I can interpret what I am observing without leaving the gym or opening the GDD.
- **As a player/investigator exploring the dev gym index**, I want the help to show the *same* icon I see on the field and an accurate one-line description, so I can recognise drops at a glance.
- **As a maintainer**, I want the help text to come from the shared catalogues so it can never drift from the implemented behaviour.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. Each of `GymPowerUpsUtility`, `GymPowerUpsCombat` and `GymWeapons` renders a `Help (?)` text button immediately next to the existing `← INDEX` button, and pressing `?` opens the same help overlay. Opening the help **pauses** the gym's simulation (movement, spawning, firing all stop) and resumes exactly where it paused on close.
2. The help overlay lists exactly the drop types the current gym can spawn, one row per drop, each showing the code-drawn icon that matches the in-game drop, the display name and a one-line description:
   - `GymPowerUpsUtility`: P5 Speed Boost, P8 Extra Life, P9 Magnet.
   - `GymPowerUpsCombat`: P3 Shield, P4 Bomb, P6 Phase Shift, P7 Teleport.
   - `GymWeapons`: Cannon (permanent default), Spread, Dual, Rapid, Reset.
3. Help descriptions are sourced from the shared gameplay catalogues — a `description` field on `POWER_UP_CATALOGUE` (`src/powerups/types.ts`) and on the weapon catalogue plus a Reset entry (`src/utils/weapons.ts`) — so the help cannot drift from implemented behaviour; every catalogue entry exposes a non-empty `description`.
4. Closing the help via `?`, the overlay's `Close` control, or **ESC** resumes the gym. While the help overlay is open, **ESC closes the help and does not exit to the main menu**; once closed, ESC again returns to the main menu as it does today. The `Close` control is focused by default and operable by keyboard (Tab / arrow keys + Enter / Space).
5. The `Help (?)` button is placed adjacent to the existing `← INDEX` button without overlapping it, and the overlay is an opaque full-screen replacement (consistent with `PauseScene`) that is legible at the game's fixed 16:9 resolution.
6. Automated tests cover the shared helper, the `HelpScene`, and its integration into all three gyms (open pauses; content matches the gym's drop pool; `?`/`Close`/ESC resume; ESC does not reach the menu while open). **The full project test suite passes with the new changes.**
7. All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries (GDD §4.4 catalogue table and §6.4 gym sections).

### Constraints

- **No external art assets** — icons must reuse the existing code-drawn drawers `drawPowerUpIcon` / `drawWeaponIcon` (`src/powerups/icons.ts`), per the GDD §7.1 code-first convention.
- **The new `HelpScene` must not live in `src/scenes/gym/`**: gym scenes are auto-discovered by `import.meta.glob('../scenes/gym/*.ts')`, so a file placed there would appear as a bogus entry in the gym index. It belongs in `src/scenes/` and must be registered in `src/core/gameConfig.ts`.
- **Do not change existing navigation semantics**: the `← INDEX` button must still return to `GymIndex`, and ESC must still return to the main menu when help is closed.
- **Paused scenes do not receive keyboard input** (`KeyboardPlugin.isActive()` is false while paused), so the `?`/ESC *close* handling must live in `HelpScene`, not in the paused gym.
- The overlay is a dev/gym affordance; the shipped `PlayScene` is out of scope.

### Existing state

- The three gyms each call `addBackToIndexButton(this)` and `addBackToMenuOnEsc(this)` (`src/utils/gymNavigation.ts`); there is no help button, no `?` handling, and no help/legend screen anywhere in the game.
- `POWER_UP_CATALOGUE` (`src/powerups/types.ts`) holds P3–P9 with `id`, `name`, `type`, optional `duration`/`maxStacks`, but **no description**. `WEAPON_CATALOGUE` (`src/utils/weapons.ts`) holds `cannon`/`spread`/`dual`/`rapid` with `id`, `name`, pattern data and **no description**; `reset` is a drop type with no catalogue entry.
- Each gym already owns an ordered list of the drops it spawns: `NON_COMBAT_ORDER` (`P5,P8,P9`), `COMBAT_ORDER` (`P3,P4,P6,P7`), `ROUND_ROBIN_ORDER` (`spread,dual,rapid,reset`).
- `PauseScene` (`src/scenes/PauseScene.ts`) is the precedent for a full-screen overlay that pauses gameplay and uses `FocusManager` for keyboard-operable controls; it is registered in `gameConfig.ts`.

### Desired change

1. Add a `description` string to every `POWER_UP_CATALOGUE` entry and every `WEAPON_CATALOGUE` entry, plus a description for the `reset` drop (e.g. a small typed map/entry alongside the weapon catalogue), derived from GDD §4.4. Proposed one-line copy:
   - P3 Shield — "Absorbs one hit; a bubble protects the ship for 15 s."
   - P4 Bomb — "Instantly clears every on-screen enemy bullet (no enemy damage)."
   - P5 Speed Boost — "+50% movement speed for 10 s."
   - P6 Phase Shift — "3 s of intangibility — pass through enemies and bullets."
   - P7 Teleport — "Stores a use; press S or ↓ to warp to the nearest safe spot and gain 3 s Phase Shift on arrival."
   - P8 Extra Life — "+1 life immediately (starts at 3, capped at 5)."
   - P9 Magnet — "Permanently pulls nearby drops toward the ship (stacks up to 5)."
   - Cannon — "Permanent default weapon — one bullet straight ahead."
   - Spread — "Adds a 3-bullet fan (−30°/0°/+30°) for 10 s."
   - Dual — "Adds two side-by-side bullets for 10 s."
   - Rapid — "Adds single bullets at a much higher fire rate for 10 s."
   - Reset — "Clears all timed weapons, leaving only the Cannon."
2. Add a shared gym help helper (proposed `src/utils/gymHelp.ts`) exposing `addHelpButton(scene, { gymKey, drops })`, where `drops` is the gym's ordered drop list (`DropId | 'cannon'`). It renders the `Help (?)` button next to `← INDEX`, and on pointerdown or `?` keydown calls `scene.scene.pause()` then `scene.scene.launch('HelpScene', { gymKey, drops })`. It also exposes the id → `{ name, description, drawIcon }` lookup used by both the button and the overlay so icons/names/descriptions have one source.
3. Add `src/scenes/HelpScene.ts`: an opaque full-screen overlay titled with the gym label, rendering one row per requested drop (code-drawn icon + name + wrapped description), plus a focused `Close` control. It handles `?`, ESC and the `Close` control by `scene.stop()`-ing itself and `scene.resume(gymKey)`-ing the originating gym. Register it in `src/core/gameConfig.ts`.
4. Wire `addHelpButton` into the three gyms, passing each gym's existing drop-order constant (and `['cannon', ...ROUND_ROBIN_ORDER]` for `GymWeapons`).
5. Update the GDD §4.4/§6.4 and README gym sections, and add code comments documenting the overlay and the new catalogue description fields.

### Key Files (predicted)

- `src/powerups/types.ts` — Add a `description` field to `PowerUpEntry` and a one-line description to every P3–P9 catalogue entry.
- `src/utils/weapons.ts` — Add a `description` field to `WeaponDefinition` and descriptions for cannon/spread/dual/rapid; add a `reset` description entry.
- `src/utils/gymHelp.ts` — **New.** `addHelpButton(scene, config)`, the `HelpDropId` type and the id → `{ name, description, drawIcon }` lookup shared by the button and overlay.
- `src/scenes/HelpScene.ts` — **New.** Full-screen opaque help overlay scene (icon + name + description rows, focused `Close`, `?`/ESC handling, resume-gym lifecycle).
- `src/core/gameConfig.ts` — Register `HelpScene` so it can be launched from the dynamically-added gym scenes.
- `src/scenes/gym/GymPowerUpsUtility.ts` — Call `addHelpButton` with `NON_COMBAT_ORDER`.
- `src/scenes/gym/GymPowerUpsCombat.ts` — Call `addHelpButton` with `COMBAT_ORDER`.
- `src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts` — Call `addHelpButton` with the cannon + `ROUND_ROBIN_ORDER` drop list.
- `src/utils/gymHelp.test.ts` — **New.** Unit tests for the lookup/description coverage and button wiring.
- `src/scenes/HelpScene.test.ts` — **New.** Scene-level tests (open pauses; content per gym; `?`/`Close`/ESC resume; ESC does not reach the menu while open).
- `src/scenes/gym/GymPowerUpsUtility.test.ts`, `GymPowerUpsCombat.test.ts`, `GymWeapons.test.ts` — Extend with help-button/overlay integration assertions.
- `docs/Game Design Document.md` — Document the gym help overlay and the catalogue `description` fields (§4.4 / §6.4).
- `README.md` — Document the `Help (?)` affordance in the gym sections.

### Risks and assumptions

- **Input routing risk (mitigated by design):** a paused Phaser scene does not receive keyboard events, so the `?`/ESC *close* handling must live in `HelpScene`; if it were left on the gym the overlay could not be dismissed by keyboard. Tests must assert resume-on-close.
- **Discovery risk (mitigated by constraint):** placing `HelpScene` in `src/scenes/gym/` would leak it into the gym index; the brief pins it to `src/scenes/` + `gameConfig.ts` registration.
- **Drift risk (mitigated by AC3):** descriptions are read from the catalogues rather than duplicated in the overlay, so a future balance change to a drop's effect forces the help text to change in one place.
- **Copy-review risk:** the proposed one-line descriptions are derived from GDD §4.4; if the producer prefers shorter/rewritten copy, only the catalogue `description` strings need editing (no structural change).
- **Scope-creep risk:** extending the help to the full-pool combat formation gyms (`GymEnemies`/`GymBoss`) and to the shipped `PlayScene` is deliberately **out of scope** for this item. If desired, record these as separate follow-up work items (`discovered-from:AH-0MUAYB67I002REOZ`) rather than growing this one. The shared helper is deliberately gym-agnostic so those follow-ups are cheap.
- **Assumption:** the dev gym index (and therefore the gyms) is only reachable in dev mode, so the overlay is a developer/QA affordance and needs no persistence or localisation.

### Related work

- **Gym index scene (AH-0MT985VRY009JXLZ)** — introduces the `← INDEX` button and directory-dynamic gym discovery that the help entry point sits beside.
- **Add ESC handler to remaining direct gym scenes (AH-0MUA9BBFV004Y1T0)** — establishes the ESC-to-menu behaviour the help overlay must not break while open.
- **Create gym scene for power-ups with spawning, collection, and standalone HUD (AH-0MTC0QPS60005MNT)** — the `GymPowerUpsUtility` gym whose drops the help documents.
- **Weapon power-ups (3 patterns + reset) with auto-fire and weapon gym scene (AH-0MTC1TEXR006I5XR)** — the `GymWeapons` gym and the weapon/reset drop set.
- **Create combat gym scene for combat-coupled power-ups (AH-0MTC2P6G3007PJ40)** — the `GymPowerUpsCombat` gym and the P3/P4/P6/P7 drop set.
- **Power-up catalogue + effects (P5, P8, P9) (AH-0MTCNZX16007ECPS)** and **Catalogue extension: P3, P4, P6, P7 entries (AH-0MTE8EB36003YF0S)** — the catalogues that gain the `description` field.
- **In-game menu (AH-0MU9LPZ0G0015292)** — the `PauseScene` + `FocusManager` overlay pattern the help overlay should mirror.
- **Docs: GymPowerUps scene + ui/HUD.ts in GDD & README (AH-0MTCO0R4D0043TDL)** — the documentation surfaces to update.

### Appendix: clarifying questions and answers

- **Q1 (scope of gym scenes).** Which scenes get the help overlay? — **Answer (Producer, interactive reply):** **A** — shared, gym-agnostic helper + `HelpScene`, wired into the three named gyms only (`GymPowerUpsUtility`, `GymPowerUpsCombat`, `GymWeapons`). Source: interactive reply to the intake agent, 2026-09-23.
- **Q2 (open/close and pause semantics).** How does help open/close and what does ESC do while it is open? — **Answer (Producer):** **A** — `?` or the `Help (?)` button opens and pauses the gym; `?` / `Close` / ESC closes and resumes; while help is open ESC closes help first and never exits to the menu. Source: interactive reply to the intake agent, 2026-09-23.
- **Q3 (content source of truth and entries).** Where do descriptions live and what does each list include? — **Answer (Producer):** **A** — add a `description` field to `POWER_UP_CATALOGUE` and the weapon catalogue (plus a reset entry), render help from the catalogues; `GymWeapons` lists Spread/Dual/Rapid/Reset plus the permanent Cannon. Source: interactive reply to the intake agent, 2026-09-23.
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **AH-0MTFRQR42001M8WQ** – Scheme-aware input tests for affected gym scenes (completed)
- **AH-0MTVYBL2L0085G6G** – One Tank changes colour (completed)
- **AH-0MUD9R2OG009RA8N** – Extract input, teleport, explosion and bullet-clear into CombatScene (completed)

### Repository file matches

data.description:
The player ship config is saved via the gym scene UI (changing controlScheme to "asteroids" and clicking Save). The save appears to succeed and the running game reflects the change. However, after restarting the game server, the ship config reverts to the default (fourDirectional) instead of preserving the saved asteroids scheme.

**Key observations:**
- The gym scene Save button calls `saveShipConfig()` which writes to `src/data/ship-config.csv` via the Vite dev server plugin.
- The git working tree shows `src/data/ship-config.csv` WAS modified (controlScheme changed from fourDirectional to asteroids), but the comment block at the top of the file was stripped by the save.
- The Vite dev server in dev mode loads ship config via `/api/csv/src/data/ship-config.csv` (served by the configCsvPlugin).
- The bug: persisted value does not survive a restart of the game server.
data.title: Ship config controlScheme does not survive game server restart
